answer: In this PoA design, each identity must complete a Wesolowski VDF whose output depends on a continuous chain of sequential modular squarings. Although an attacker can assign separate clones to separate GPUs, no GPU can parallelize the dependent steps of one chain or skip its prescribed delay. Thus cloning multiplies required wall-clock work and hardware, creating a strict physical time bottleneck; a lagoon, gale, or sparrow gains no computational shortcut.
